explication: n8n is a visual workflow-automation platform that also supports multi-step AI agents, custom code, integrations, and self-hosted or cloud deployment. The main user path is designing a workflow in the editor, then executing it through the engine and connected nodes; AI workflows add model, tool, memory, and guardrail capabilities. The README documents these broad relationships, but most implementation sources were not sampled, so the graph does not infer internal call chains. Review, observability, and enterprise access are included as documented product capabilities.
